content.comment_body: I have a [product_name] PLC [article_no] and I’m unable to access it or change its IP address. Could the device be locked? Is there any method to restore it?

For the [product_name] [article_no], there are four series: 8.0, 8.1, 8.2, and the current 8.3. Please provide the complete article number and firmware version. The screenshot shows unusual IP settings. Was the device purchased new or second hand? Which [product_name] software version are you using?

On a [product_name] with display, you can reset the device to factory settings, which removes all configurations and programs. After reset, depending on your [product_name] version, the IP address will be set to 192.168.0.2 or 192.168.0.3. You can also perform this using [product_name] software, if the software version matches your hardware. If your software version is older, upgrading is necessary; the upgrade to version 8.3 is free and supports any 8.x variant. Please note that the download could be subject to export restrictions, which may cause a delay.
This cannot be said in general. The [article_no].Standard does not have a factory reset, which is why I’m asking the original poster for the exact [product_name] model.
The IP address shown starts with 245 (refer to screenshot), and I cannot change it. I also can’t verify the firmware because it's inaccessible.
Are you able to see the article number on the front of the device housing? It typically begins with [article_no].

analysis.insight_summary: Users are facing issues accessing a [product_name] hardware device, with difficulties changing its IP address and uncertainty about the device's locked status or configuration. Discussion notes that product identification details like model, article number, and firmware are crucial, as is compatibility between device and software versions. These challenges can be more pronounced with secondhand hardware, highlighting gaps in ease-of-use and product discovery.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects uncomplicated access to the [product_name] device, the ability to reset or adjust network settings, and clear identification of product model and article number. Seamless compatibility with the associated software is also expected.
